answer.title: Automate Quote Lead Creation
answer.trigger: A new quote request email is received from a potential customer.
steps: Read the incoming quote request email.
Extract the customer name, contact details, and job description.
Check if the lead already exists in the crm.
Create a new lead in the crm using the extracted details.
answer.ai_help: Extracting customer details and job requirements from the unstructured email text.
answer.risk_reason: Creating a duplicate or slightly mislabeled internal lead record has minimal negative impact and can be easily corrected.
